overall_summary: The historical performance indicates that broad emotional relationship topics involving husband-wife dynamics significantly outperform generic sad shayaris, individual family member tropes, or deep philosophical quotes. Content addressing everyday relationship friction and mutual understanding yields thousands of views compared to double-digit views for abstract poetry.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1679 views) massively outperform all other topics.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on couple dynamics, unspoken marital expectations, and everyday relationship evolution.

winning_patterns.evidence: Content offering perspective shifts in relationships (e.g., 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota', 392 views) performs better than purely depressive or melancholic content.
winning_patterns.action: Frame emotional hooks around common misunderstandings or unappreciated gestures between partners.

weak_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (21 views) and 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है' (19 views) generated very low engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, literary, or overly poetic titles; stick to grounded, conversational observations.

weak_patterns.pattern: Low Sample Family Tropes without Conflict
weak_patterns.evidence: Generic family tribute videos without a relatable behavioral tension struggle to cross 200 views.
weak_patterns.action: Ensure family or relationship content highlights a specific everyday emotional friction point rather than a blanket statement.
